notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have just released patch 1.0.7 for TACTICS OF WORLD WAR 1. Thank you for your feedback on the game. I hope you like the new features, i.e. the tactical pause and the option to not remove fallen from the battlefield. As always, I have also fixed some bugs.

[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where tutorial videos would not be played
[*] Fixed an issue where the Windows mouse cursor would not fade out during cutscenes and loading screens.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would not pause during the victory screen
[/list]


[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a tactical pause to the game (the game is paused, but orders can still be issued)
[*] Added an option to not remove fallen soldiers from the battlefield
[/list]


Thank you for your patience, feedback and continued support.

Headless Horseman

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have just released patch 1.0.6 for TACTICS OF WORLD WAR 1.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in level 5 where neutral units would stop fighting.
[*] Fixed an issue where units near obstacles had suboptimal pathfinding
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replaced still images in some tutorial screens with video clips
[*] Improved the game flow in level 1 to better explain mechanics.
[*] Increased the maximum zoom level
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and continued support.

Headless Horseman

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have just released update 1.0.5 for TACTICS OF WORLD WAR 1.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a graphical issue where the terrain had gaps in some levels.
[*] Fixed an issue where units would stop attacking after throwing a grenade.
[*] Fixed an issue where units could get trapped inside a trench.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a progress bar and sound effects when cutting barbed wire.
[*] Improved the animation of rifleman when shooting at moving enemies.
[/list]

For the next patch, I plan to make some improvements to the tutorial. I have also started to create the roster of the French unit. A showcase is coming soon.

As always, if you come across a bug or have suggestions for improvements, please contact me via the Community Hub or by sending an email to the support mail.

Headless Horseman

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This patch continues to improve the game's pathfinding and should make the use of grenades less clunky.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Highlight when a grenade is aimed at a building.
[*] Improved accuracy for grenade throws.
[*] Improved pathfinding in trenches and near cover.
[*] Improved placement of units behind cover.
[/list]

If you come across a bug or have suggestions for improvements, please contact me via the Community Hub or send an email to the support mail.

Headless Horseman

notes.title: Tactics of World War I Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have just released update 1.0.3 for TACTICS OF WORLD WAR 1. This update has taken longer than expected, but should fix some serious bugs that are causing the game to crash.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial screen would not close properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where units were not placed on the ground.
[*] Fixed an issue with the ragdoll animation of the machine gunners.
[*] Fixed causes of crashes in the game.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a north indicator to the game map.
[*] The AI of the counterattack units in level 2 has been made more active.
[/list]

Special thanks to G66 for helping me identify the cause of some bugs and suggesting improvements. If you come across a bug yourself or have suggestions for improvements, please contact me via the Community Hub or by sending an email to the support mail.

Headless Horseman

notes.title: Tactics of World War I Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I've just released update 1.0.2 for TACTICS OF WORLD WAR 1. This update addresses some of the bugs that were reported in the first days after release. There are unfortunately other bugs that have been reported by players that have yet to be fixed, but I'm trying to get those fixed as quickly as possible as well.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several pathfinding issues that caused units to get stuck or move through obstacles.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would start but the would remain black.
[/list]
If the game still starts with a black screen, try launching the game with the start option "-low_res".

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Accepting changes in the settings menu will not result in returning to the main menu
[/list]

Thank you for your patience, feedback and support!

Headless Horseman
